description.value: Whisk Matcha Cafe is a female-owned premium matcha cafe and retail space in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, sourcing artisanal Japanese matcha directly from small independent farms in Uji, Kyoto. Opened in 2020, the brick-and-mortar location pairs an in-person matcha drink bar with an extensive curated selection of premium matcha powders and traditional tea wares. The business has grown to supply over 100 cafe wholesale partners across North America, making it a notable destination for matcha enthusiasts.
